title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode7 Wish

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't go back and change what happened that day...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have to keep composing.
That's all I can do now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I feel pretty refreshed now.
I might actually be able to finish one of my illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll be working like normal, so let me know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K, I wanna ask you something...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My illustration for the post-chorus feels kinda dark at the moment, but I'm wondering if I should add a little more light... What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry...
I was thinking about something else, so I couldn't gather my thoughts properly.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, are you talking about your future...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's not bothering me that much, but it does keep nagging at me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But I'm okay...
I feel a lot better after talking with Rin just now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I tried thinking about what I want to do, but I couldn't come up with anything...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, there was a time when I really loved music more than anything else...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sure. My happiest memories all seem to involve music in some way...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <My mom and dad always smiled whenever they heard a song that I composed.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That explains why your songs feel so warm, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The memories you just mentioned might be the source of the warmth I feel in your songs. It makes so much sense now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, are you gonna keep composing after you graduate?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, um... Yes.
I plan to keep on composing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Especially... Since that's what I need to do...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I realized something while talking about this...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No matter how many songs I do compose, I'll never be able to feel the warmth I did back then ever again...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I know there's nothing I can do about that now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But my dad losing his ability to compose is still my fault...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's why I need to keep composing. For him. For everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If I can compose songs that save others, then I'll...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know you feel awful about what happened to your dad, but there's no point in beating yourself up...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What I'm trying to say is... I think your happiness is a separate issue.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Personally, I don't want those two things being so closely tied together...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you're working so hard for the sake of others...! You deserve to be happy too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Wanting to learn how to write wonderful songs like your father is a beautiful dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: But I'll be happy as long as you find something that makes you happy, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You tried to suppress whatever you were feeling just now...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You believe that you're not allowed to be happy. That you have no right to.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm okay with you composing songs in order to save others and make them feel happy.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I'm not okay with you turning a blind eye to what you're really feeling...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Before you formed N25, and even now... The songs you've composed have helped me so much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Every time I listen to one of your songs whenever I'm not feeling great... Whenever I wonder if I should continue drawing, the thought of creating art for N25 keeps me going.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I feel pain sometimes when I'm working on an illustration... But I want to keep drawing.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Plus, I've actually started thinking about what I wanna do after I graduate.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I doubt I'd be giving that any serious thought if I hadn't joined N25...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're the reason why I'm even thinking about my own future.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's a small step, but I have something to work towards now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, Kanade...
I think you should also do what makes you the happiest.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If there is something you wish to do, you shouldn't fight against it.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Because there's no way you'll be able to save her if you don't cherish your own feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<KAITO, wait!
Ugh. He always storms off after saying whatever it is that's on his mind...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Am I allowed to feel the way I did back then...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I robbed Dad of his future...)
